name: mumu-claude-plugin
description: Four Claude Code plugins: a team that lands reviewed pull requests, documents, verification, and lessons that compound.

plugins.name: mumu-document
plugins.description: Documents a person reads outside the chat: GitHub bodies, Artifact pages, repository pages.

plugins.name: mumu-team
plugins.description: Work lands only as a PR merged at a sha a reviewer approved.

plugins.name: mumu-verification
plugins.description: A change is checked against a contract that predates it.

plugins.name: mumu-compounding
plugins.description: A lesson is filed once, where its reader looks, before the session ends.
